title: Video face detailer
description:
UNBLOCKED 2026-08-21 - BOTH blockers are done, the card just did not know it. MPI-579 (LTX Video upscaler plugin) shipped, and MPI-580 (the plugin entity - a dropdown entry, plugin-owned controls, and the mechanism that lets a Flow DECLARE a plugin requirement) shipped with it. That mechanism is the exact thing the text below waits on. Nothing blocks this Flow now.

WHAT IS LEFT TO BENCH is narrower than the card's step-5 three-way: the LTX arm is a known quantity rather than a candidate, so the only open question is whether it beats SeedVR2 and plain .pth AT FACE-CROP SCALE.

UNBLOCKED FROM MPI-568 on 2026-08-19 - the bench reported: LTX v2v is a reconstructor, the range is sigmas 0.50-0.85 (default 0.675) and cfg 1-3 (default 1.0), and it runs 4.13 Mpx in ONE pass with no chunking. NOW BLOCKED ON MPI-579 INSTEAD. Fabio, 2026-08-19: "Video Face Detailer will adopt this upscaler that we've built. So the plug-in will be a requirement for it, as it is a flow." So this Flow no longer benches its own regenerative arm - it consumes the shipped LTX Video upscaler plugin, and the mechanism that lets a Flow declare a plugin requirement is MPI-580's. The step-5 three-way bench below is reshaped by that, not deleted: the LTX arm is now a known quantity rather than a candidate, so what is left to bench is whether it beats SeedVR2 and plain .pth AT FACE-CROP SCALE.

BLOCKED 2026-08-17 on MPI-568 (LTX spatial upscaler bench) - Fabio: the results of MPI-568 decide whether this card's step-5 sampler bench is even the right shape, so 568 runs first. Do not start MPI-557 until MPI-568 reports. Detail small faces in video without per-frame identity flicker: crop a stable face window, resample it with a TEMPORAL sampler, graft only its high frequencies back. Experimental - Phase 0 is a bench GO/NO-GO before any app work. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-15: the SeedVR2 node choice is settled - the BUNDLED CORE NODES win a measured bake-off against the numz pack (core resolves ~50% more detail at matched chunk size, and BlockSwap does not fix the OOM). Take comfy_extras.nodes_seedvr as the sampler. Evidence: MPI-506 brief 2f-ter. STEP-5 IS NOW A THREE-WAY BENCH, 2026-08-16 (Fabio): add a plain .pth upscale-with-model arm (ImageUpscaleWithModel - 4x_NMKD-Siax_200k, or better 1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1, a 1x skin-detail model that never rescales) and compare it HEAD-TO-HEAD against SeedVR2 on the same crop, with LTX v2v as the regenerative third. .pth has no temporal model, so no chunking, no VRAM ceiling, seconds not minutes - but also no temporal coherence, so bench for FLICKER, not sharpness. Do NOT restate this as 'they are equivalent': at full frame SIAX measures mid 1.23 / top 1.10 against lanczos (near no-op) vs SeedVR2's 6.18 / 3.50; the open question is whether that gap still matters at 128x128 crop scale. SCOPE OF THE SEEDVR2 DROP: MPI-506's standalone plugin feature is dropped (sharpens rather than reconstructs, no semantic prior, ~10 min per second at 3x), but SeedVR2 REMAINS a live candidate inside this workflow - Fabio: 'SeedVR2 is still usable in that workflow of the Video Face Detailer'. On a face crop the VRAM and runtime objections largely evaporate (~100x fewer pixels than a full frame).
